evidence: Homepage lists 6 templates (Professional Resume, Professional Email, Weekly Status Report, Meeting Minutes, Project Proposal, Academic Research Summary), each showing description, author name, use count, category/scenario tags, and update date.
Each template card shows name (e.g. "Professional Resume"), author (Sarah Chen), description, type tag (Resume/Business), and "Updated 2024-12-01" date.
Clicking "Use Template" on Professional Resume opened a modal dialog titled "Professional Resume" with Fill Template / Preview Result tabs.
Filled all 13 fields (Full Name, Job Title, Email, Phone, Summary, Company, Position, Start/End Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills) successfully via form inputs.
After filling required fields, "Preview Result" tab became enabled; clicking it rendered a formatted preview of the filled resume.

Preview shows "Timothee Issenmann", "Senior Software Engineer | timothee.issenmann@gmail.com | +1 234 567 8900", Tech Corp — Senior Developer, Jan 2020 - Present, responsibilities, B.S. Computer Science — MIT, 2018, Skills list — all matching entered form data with proper Markdown headings rendered as HTML.
Preview content renders with correct headings (h1/h2/h3), bold/italic emphasis, and separators without any raw markdown syntax or formatting errors visible.
Before filling required fields, the dialog showed "Required fields missing" alert listing missing fields, and the Preview Result tab was disabled, preventing preview generation.
When required fields were empty, a visible warning banner "Required fields missing / Please fill in: ..." appeared and Preview Result tab was visually disabled (greyed out, not clickable).
Clicking "Copy to Clipboard" on the preview produced a toast: "Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied."

actual: Entered "NotADate123" into the required Start Date field; no error message or format validation appeared, and the field accepted the invalid value. Date fields are plain free-text inputs with no format checking.
Set Start Date to "Dec 2025" and End Date to "Jan 2020" (start after end); no validation error was shown and the form accepted the values without restriction.
Typed "￥#@%^*Test" into the Full Name field; all special characters were accepted verbatim with no filtering and no "Special characters are prohibited" message.

issue: No visual feedback for special character input
actual: Entering special characters (￥#@%^*) into the Full Name field produced no visual feedback, warning, or blocking of input.

evidence: Clicking the heart icon on "Professional Resume" card changed it to a filled heart (class fill-current) with highlighted background (bg-primary/10 text-primary), providing clear visual feedback of the favorite state change.
Clicking the heart icon on Professional Resume added it to favorites; header "Favorites" button now shows a count badge "1".
Clicking "Favorites" button filtered the template list to "Showing 1 of 6 templates", displaying only the previously favorited "Professional Resume" template.
Typing "resu" (partial fuzzy keyword) matched and displayed "Professional Resume" template, both as a suggestion dropdown and filtered result list.

Typing "resu" showed a real-time suggestion dropdown item "Professional Resume"; clicking it filled the search box with the full template name and filtered the list to show only that corresponding template ("Showing 1 of 6 templates").
As soon as "resu" was typed, the template list immediately updated to "Showing 1 of 6 templates" without needing a submit action, demonstrating real-time filtering.

Category filter "Resume" correctly narrowed list to 1/6 templates. Sort By "Recently Updated" correctly reordered templates by update date descending (2024-12-05, 12-01, 11-28, 11-15, 10-20, 09-30). Scenario and Sort By (Most Popular/Recently Updated/Oldest First/Alphabetical) dropdowns also present.

Clicking "Submit Template" with empty Title, Author Name, Description, and Content fields triggered a toast: "Missing required fields / Please fill in all required fields." and the dialog remained open, blocking submission.

Filled Title, Author Name, Description, Markdown Content (with {{field}} placeholders), and defined 5 template fields; submission succeeded with toast "Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library."

After submission, "Simple Cover Letter" immediately appeared in the public template grid, list count updated from "6 of 6" to "7 of 7 templates", showing correct author (Timothee Issenmann), description, category tag, and 0 uses.

Immediately after submitting, the template library updated in real time to show "Simple Cover Letter" as a new card without requiring a page reload, and the "Showing X of Y" counter synchronized to 7 of 7.

issue: No Markdown syntax validation on submission
actual: Submitted a template with clearly malformed Markdown (unclosed ``` code block, unclosed **bold, broken [link( syntax); the app accepted it with the same "Template submitted!" success toast and added it to the library without any syntax warning or rejection.
